summary: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut. Not interactive.

pairs.why: At 20px tall, radius/lg (10px) turns a key cap into a pill and it stops reading as a key.
pairs.source: Corrected in Figma and code, 28 Sept

pairs.dont: Use On Emphasis on a light surface.
pairs.do: Use On Emphasis only inside a filled surface, such as a primary Button.
pairs.why: Its fill is 18% white over whatever is beneath it; on a light surface it disappears.

pairs.dont: Put a whole shortcut in one Kbd ("Ctrl+K").
pairs.do: One key per Kbd, wrapped in KbdGroup.
pairs.why: Each key reads as its own cap, and KbdGroup renders as nested <kbd>, which is the semantic markup for a key combination.

a11y: Renders <kbd>, so assistive tech can identify it as keyboard input.
Icon-only keys (e.g. ⌘) need a text alternative nearby or an aria-label on the Kbd.
